description: On-chain spending guardrails for an AI agent wallet on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30.1): an owner sets a policy (maximum amount, single allowed receiver, minimum reputation, high-value tier) and the agent can only send SOL through submit_transaction when the policy passes; the owner can freeze and unfreeze the agent. All five instructions were verified with real devnet transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of MayankSen09/SentinelAI. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/SentinelAI. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (policy gate, reputation, freeze)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/sentinel-ai/
QA: devnet proof of agent spending guardrails
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Redesign the circuit breaker so rejected attempts are recorded
